Escape into the High Sierra wilderness, where granite peaks rise above quiet alpine lakes, evening light washes across the mountains, and steam drifts through sunlit pines beside a flowing creek.
Filmed on location by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel, High Sierra Wilderness invites you to slow down and spend time with the beauty of California's Sierra Nevada. Gentle acoustic music, spacious views, and moments of flowing water create a peaceful setting for a quiet break or an unhurried evening at home.
Let your screen become a window into the wilderness. Watch closely, settle in, and enjoy the changing light—or let the scenery bring a sense of mountain calm to your room.
Filmed and produced by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel for NatureStream.tv.
The nature footage is real and was filmed on location; no AI-generated scenery is used. Music generated with Suno AI, then selected, edited, and mixed for NatureStream.tv.
Run time: 1 hour, 44 minutes.
